name: Cloudflare tunnel
author: Mox Neo
description: Join-only token connector. It dials out only and does not publish 80 or 443.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
arch=$(uname -m)
case "$arch" in
  x86_64)
    asset=cloudflared-linux-amd64
    sum=77e26d8d900e0b8469f416239d14b5f296525fdf79fee6f511ef55609e3fbac2
    ;;
  aarch64)
    asset=cloudflared-linux-arm64
    sum=aaeb2d7d0da3614634c7e03ab13487a1522c2e79165ed2929cfe23d5e95b326d
    ;;
  *)
    echo "unsupported architecture: $arch" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/cloudflared "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/download/2026.9.3/${asset}"
echo "${sum}  /mnt/server/cloudflared" | sha256sum -c -
chmod 755 /mnt/server/cloudflared
